name: What should homeowners prepare before kitchen backsplash installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before kitchen backsplash installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our crew arrives, clear everything off the kitchen countertops, including small appliances, knife blocks, and dish racks. Empty upper cabinet contents if you have delicate glassware that could rattle during wall preparation, and provide clear path access from entryways to the kitchen. Having your chosen tile on-site prior to work allows us to inspect boxes for dye-lot consistency and shipping damage. If your project includes wider kitchen upgrades, owner Abraham Becerra will outline the specific sequence of drywall prep, cabinet finish work, and tile setting during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all items off countertops, remove fragile items from adjacent cabinets, verify tile materials are on-site, and ensure clear walking paths for the installation crew.
